unlisted_practices: Expand AI model training data to include a wider range of demographic populations to improve generalizability.
Integrate other imaging modalities to improve AI detection of rare lesions such as pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.
Implement a tiered diagnostic approach to limit false-positive follow-up procedures and costs from a highly specific AI screening model.

screen.reason: This is an invited commentary/editorial discussing the clinical deployment challenges and validation requirements for the PANDA pancreatic cancer screening AI model.
